items.title: Merged: Supplier order export (CSV + EDI)
items.body: PR #412 by tom-shelfwise. Stores can export forecast-based purchase orders directly to their suppliers. Deployed to production.

facts.text: Shipped supplier order export: stores send forecast-based purchase orders straight to suppliers

items.title: Release v2.0.0: Fresh produce forecasting
items.body: Tag v2.0.0. Forecasting now covers fresh produce (fruit, vegetables, bakery) with daily spoilage-aware models. Rolled out to all customers. Closes #188, the most upvoted feature request.

facts.text: Release 2.0: fresh produce forecasting is live for all customers (most requested feature)
